temporal_holdout.leakage_prevention_note: Training set uses all months before the cutoff date. Test set uses all months from the cutoff onward. No random splitting was performed; adjacent time periods are never split between train and test.

spatial_holdout.note: Country fixed effects are dropped from the spatial-holdout formula because the held-out countries were unseen during training.

cross_sensor_agreement.note: Correlation does not imply interchangeability. VIIRS systematically detects more hotspots than MODIS due to finer resolution and higher sensitivity.

diagnostics.training_support: positive country-month-sensor records where both sensor families reported detections
limitations: FIRMS detections do not include sensor observation-opportunity/exposure.
No non-detection records were supplied; missing sensor-months were not converted to zero.
The index is exploratory and not a corrected absolute fire count or detection probability.
MODIS (0-100 numeric) and VIIRS (l/n/h categorical) confidence scales remain separate and were not used as equivalent weights.
The baseline estimates sensor-family effects, not individual spacecraft offsets; platform details remain in the output metadata.
A hotspot detection is not necessarily a unique fire.
The monthly country-level index does not claim to reconstruct individual fire events.
The 95 % intervals are model confidence intervals for expected counts and do not include missing-exposure uncertainty.
FRP measurements are not assumed interchangeable across sensors.
